title: Feedback needed on my 2D tap-to-jump semi-platformer prototype (gameplay video included)
author: QuickTraining4473

comments.author: MakkoMakkerton
comments.body: Looks cool, what tools did you use to build it out?

replies.author: QuickTraining4473
replies.body:
I am using unity  game engine and c# code .  

I would love to have feedback or suggestions from you guyz to make better game play

replies.author: MakkoMakkerton
replies.body: Game play is always just person dependent honestly what some may like others not like, I've been more focused on art assets for game recently!

replies.author: QuickTraining4473
replies.body:
Agreed , but i think gameplay should  fun and engaging.

How do you feel about this game’s art style?

replies.author: MakkoMakkerton
replies.body: I like it, its subtle, but I do think if your plan is to market it and try and get some rev rewards you want to spice it up a bit, right now it looks great but does feel like its missing its own artistic element

replies.author: QuickTraining4473
replies.body: Sure ,thanks for your feedback i will surly add some spice and reward part in it .right now its in very early stage

replies.author: MakkoMakkerton
replies.body: Game devs refer to it as "juice" if you tell the ai you want more "juice"  it will add the flair

comments.author: DangiGuerrillaFlow_
comments.body: The camera follow will look good, but I guess it was just background moving independently( first level). make camara follow the player's movement

replies.author: QuickTraining4473
replies.body: Hey thanks for the suggestion, i will definitely try it out to see the results
